# Sequence Coordinates

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SequenceCoordinates`](gmeow-SequenceCoordinates.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SequenceCoordinates>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Frame-relative coordinates on a biological sequence: a start position, an end position, and a strand orientation, all expressed relative to an explicit reference assembly ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).
